{{Quote|By destroying the dreadnought and spreading word that the Dread Masters had been killed, the Council hoped to prevent the Emperor from making any attempt to locate them. The truth was, however, that the Council believed the Dread Master were far too valuable to dispose of.|Grand Master Satele Shan|<ref name="JoMGD" />}}
In [[3668 BBY]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and [[Republic Special Forces Division]] organized '''a mission to stop''' the [[Dread Masters]]&mdash;a group of six ancient [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] who were terrorizing Republic [[Republic Navy/Legends|naval]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]] through use of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. The Dread Masters' [[Force power/Legends|power]] in [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magic]] allowed them to remotely and anonymously induce crippling fear in enemy [[Starship/Legends|vessels]], sending their crews fleeing in panic and seriously damaging the Republic war effort. Despite efforts to keep the six of them hidden aboard a [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]], Imperial communications regarding their identity and location was intercepted by the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]], allowing [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaric Kaedan]] and a Republic Special Forces [[Squad/Legends|team]] to plan a strike against the Dread Masters. The operation was successful and ended with the capture of the Sith Lords and the Republic's acquisition of a highly-classified [[Imperial Database X-4367|Imperial database]]. Although [[Dread Masters' dreadnaught|their dreadnaught]] was destroyed, the Masters were kept alive and ferried to [[The Tomb]], a maximum security section of the Republic's [[Belsavis prison|secret prison]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|In a string of recent confrontations with the Empire, dozens of Republic warships had gone missing, leaving evidence that they fled after personnel on board were overcome by a profound and mysterious terror.|Jedi Master Gnost-Dural|<ref name="JoMGD" />}}
==The mission==
{{Quote|Working with an elite Republic Special Forces team, Jedi Knight Jaric Kaedan managed to infiltrate the dreadnought and capture the Dread Masters.|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="JoMGD" />}}
==Aftermath==
{{Quote|The ancient prison on Belsavis was the only place with safety measures strong enough to ensure the Dread Masters could not escape, and it is there they remain to this day. Let us hope that they remain there for all eternity.|Satele Shan|<ref name="JoMGD" />}}
